comment: The clock output is index 6 here, at the end of the list, while on Sequel 8 and Sequel 16 the same jack is index 0; the six row gates are indices 0 to 5 and run down the right-hand edge. The rush knobs are configured with their minimum and maximum the wrong way round, 15 as the minimum and -15 as the maximum (James.cpp:375-380), and the module then negates the reading (getRushValForRow), so the knob works but its declared range reads backwards. The clock and reset inputs have no threshold: any move away from exactly 0V counts.
